'''Evac ship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used to evacuate individuals from a hostile situation. [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] used an evac ship to escape [[Queyta]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Evac ships were also used [[25 ABY/Legends|decades later]] during the [[Battle of Gyndine]], where an entire planetary population was evacuated.
